nodes.label: Blocked-Origin Isolation Demo Pattern
nodes.rationale: localhost:4000 intentionally absent from allowed_origins to demonstrate CORS blocks it — proves server-side origin enforcement without a real attack.

nodes.label: Widget Bootstrap Token (concierge.bootstrap)
nodes.rationale: Widget listens for postMessage of type 'concierge.bootstrap' to receive the signed widget token from the loader. Token is not stored in localStorage to reduce XSS attack surface.

nodes.label: Tenant Isolation as First-Class Invariant
nodes.rationale: The wall between tenants is the grade — cross-tenant reads/writes are always Critical severity regardless of code layer.

nodes.label: Clean Architecture Dependency Rule
nodes.rationale: Inner layers must not depend on outer layers. Domain/entities must not import FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Redis, LLM SDKs, or infrastructure clients.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL RLS + SET LOCAL app.tenant_id
nodes.rationale: TenantContextMiddleware sets SET LOCAL app.tenant_id before any repository call. Adapters never set it themselves — this ensures only verified auth context sets the tenant.

nodes.label: Redis TTL KEEPTTL Strategy
nodes.rationale: First write uses SET key val NX EX 3600 to start fixed 60-min clock. Subsequent writes use SET key val KEEPTTL to avoid resetting TTL accidentally (which would make keys permanent). Key schema: session:{tenant_id}:{conversation_id}.

nodes.label: pgvector HNSW Cosine-Distance RAG Retrieval
nodes.rationale: Retrieval query: SELECT ... ORDER BY embedding <=> $1 LIMIT 20 WHERE tenant_id = :tid AND cms_pages.state = 'published'. Tenant filter applied at query level, not post-retrieval.

nodes.label: Service Token from Vault (T151)
nodes.rationale: SERVICE_TOKEN env var is dev-only fallback. In production the API fetches it from Vault at startup (T151). Leaving unset in prod forces Vault as only source.
